patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I flew in on Thursday. I was working in an outbreak district — I treated patients, and I helped at a burial. The fever started yesterday, and I know exactly what that means.
clinical.presentationShort: 41yo F, MSF nurse — returned from a DRC outbreak district 4 days ago with direct patient and funeral contact. Fever 24h, severe myalgia.
clinical.presentationLong: 41-year-old aid-organisation nurse returned four days ago from an outbreak district in the DRC with direct patient and funeral contact, now with 24 hours of fever and severe muscle aches.

diagnosis.primary: Suspected viral haemorrhagic fever — malaria must be excluded in parallel
diagnosis.disposition: Acute → immediate isolation with full PPE, notify infection control and public health, thick and thin films for malaria
diagnosis.why: Identify, isolate, inform. She is an ESI 2 for danger to others, not for how sick she looks. And remember: fever in a returning traveller is malaria until proven otherwise — that is what is most likely to kill her.
diagnosis.redFlag: Fever within 21 days of high-risk outbreak exposure — isolate before anything else happens.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a white 41-year-old woman in a plain travel shirt with a surgical mask pulled down around her chin, seated on a blue padded clinic chair
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting upright and self-contained, hands deliberately folded in her lap, keeping herself apart
signs: a surgical mask around her chin
aiImageGeneration.lookSeverity: febrile and unwell but fully alert and self-possessed
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a white 41-year-old woman in a plain travel shirt with a surgical mask pulled down around her chin, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting upright and self-contained, hands deliberately folded in her lap, keeping herself apart. Expression: composed, clear-eyed and quietly grim. Clearly visible: flushed feverish cheeks; a sheen of sweat; a surgical mask around her chin. Overall: febrile and unwell but fully alert and self-possessed. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
